basics.name: Aritrika Karmakar
basics.label: Digital Marketing Executive | B2B & B2C Campaigns | Content & SEO | Multichannel Campaign Development

summaries.default: Business Development Representative with 2+ years of experience across B2B SaaS and digital marketing, supporting demand generation, lead nurturing and customer engagement. Experienced in business development, CRM management, lead qualification, outbound prospecting, campaign execution and cross-functional collaboration. MA in Media & Communications with a proven track record of supporting product launches, engaging senior stakeholders and delivering data-driven campaigns that increased engagement by 30% and generated £10K+ in revenue.
summaries.crm-lifecycle: Hi, I'm Aritrika Karmakar a London-based Marketing & CRM Executive specialising in email, lifecycle, and data-driven digital marketing that drives engagement and retention. I have experience delivering end-to-end CRM and email campaigns using HubSpot and Mailchimp, from audience segmentation and A/B testing to automation, reporting, and optimisation. I've created newsletters, built GDPR-compliant workflows, and improved open and click-through rates through insight-led iteration. Alongside CRM, I manage multi-channel digital campaigns across email, web, and LinkedIn, supporting major industry events and conferences. I enjoy working with data, refining customer journeys, and translating insights into campaigns that feel relevant, human, and effective.

preferences.note: Sourced from the LinkedIn profile's own 'about' text: keen to grow in CRM, email, and digital marketing roles, open to connecting with London-based teams. Not independently corroborated elsewhere, which is expected for a forward-looking preference statement.

recommendations.by: The Gold Award (Goldsmiths, University of London Careers Service)
recommendations.relationship: Programme-completion recognition, not a personal reference
recommendations.text: Aritrika completed the Gold Award in 2024. The Gold Award is a one-year personal and professional skills development programme run by the Goldsmiths (University of London) Careers Service. The Gold Award provides students with opportunities to identify, develop and reflect on their professional skill-set in a variety of ways. In completing the programme alongside their academic studies, Aritrika showed sustained commitment and dedication to their personal and professional development. Aritrika also participated in workshops to develop key employability skills and explore new career opportunities. Alongside attending these workshops, Aritrika completed and reflected on at least 40 hours of relevant work experience. By completing the Gold Award this year, Aritrika showed resilience and creativity in a new and evolving work environment.
